name: Mimporto Traffic Analytics – Visitor Statistics
author: Domenico Porto

sections.description:
Mimporto Traffic Analytics helps you understand your website traffic directly inside WordPress, without relying on Google Analytics or external analytics platforms.

It is designed for website owners who want a simple, fast and privacy-aware analytics dashboard with local data storage, realtime visitor statistics and clear traffic reports.

Why choose Mimporto Traffic Analytics?

  • Privacy-friendly website analytics
  • No Google Analytics account required
  • No external analytics platform required
  • Statistics stored locally in WordPress
  • Realtime visitor monitoring
  • Visitor history and pageview reports
  • Top pages and active pages reports
  • Traffic growth and trend analysis
  • AI traffic detection
  • Email summaries
  • Import and export tools
  • IP exclusion support
  • Do Not Track (DNT) support
  • Multilingual admin interface

Main Features

  • Realtime visitors dashboard
  • Visitors active in the last 30 minutes
  • Active pages monitoring
  • Historical visitor reports
  • Historical page reports
  • Top pages ranking
  • Browser, operating system and device statistics
  • Referrer statistics
  • Direct, search engine and social traffic detection
  • AI referral detection and classification
  • Traffic trend analysis
  • New pages discovery
  • Scheduled email reports
  • Import / Export tools
  • Technical diagnostics view
  • Anti-bot filtering
  • Logged-in users exclusion
  • IP exclusion support
  • Do Not Track (DNT) support
  • Multilingual administration interface

Visitor Statistics

Monitor visitors, pageviews, active pages, devices, browsers and referrers directly from your WordPress dashboard.

The realtime dashboard helps you see current activity, while the visitor history and page reports provide a clear overview of previous traffic.

Traffic Trend Analysis

The Analytics section helps you understand how your content is performing over time.

Compare a selected period with the previous one and discover:

  • Pages gaining visits
  • Pages losing visits
  • Fast-growing pages
  • Declining pages
  • New pages receiving traffic

This helps identify content opportunities and traffic changes at a glance.

Privacy Friendly

Mimporto Traffic Analytics stores analytics data locally in your WordPress database.

No external analytics platform is required.

No Google Analytics account is required.

No third-party analytics service is required.

You remain in control of your analytics data.

AI Traffic Detection

Mimporto Traffic Analytics can identify referrals coming from AI assistants and AI search tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Claude, You.com, Poe and others.

Email Reports

Receive scheduled email summaries containing:

  • Visitors
  • Pageviews
  • Top pages
  • Traffic overview

Reports are sent using the standard WordPress email system.

Multilingual Interface

The administration interface is available in:

  • English
  • Italian
  • Spanish
  • French
  • German

Technical Diagnostics

The Technical View helps understand how tracking signals are processed and consolidated into final statistics.

Useful for troubleshooting, diagnostics and tracking validation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mimporto-traffic-analytics directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the Statistics menu.
  4. Configure privacy settings and email reports if desired.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin use Google Analytics?

No. Mimporto Traffic Analytics works directly inside WordPress and does not require Google Analytics.

Does the plugin send data to external services?

No. Analytics data is stored locally inside your WordPress database.

Is the plugin privacy friendly?

Yes. The plugin is designed with privacy in mind and stores data locally without external analytics services. Website owners remain responsible for legal requirements, privacy notices and consent management.

Does it show realtime visitors?

Yes. The realtime dashboard shows visitors and active pages from the last 30 minutes.

Can I exclude administrators and specific IPs?

Yes.

Does the plugin support Do Not Track?

Yes.

Can I receive email reports?

Yes.

Can Mimporto detect visitors coming from AI assistants?

Yes. Mimporto Traffic Analytics can identify referrals coming from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Claude, You.com, Poe and other AI assistants.

Which languages are supported?

English, Italian, Spanish, French and German.

What does the Analytics section do?

It compares traffic between periods and highlights growth, decline and new pages receiving visits.
sections.changelog:
2.4.0

  • Added support for UTM source detection.
  • Added support for the src URL parameter used by some AI platforms.
  • Improved referral detection priority by giving precedence to UTM parameters over HTTP referrers.
  • Improved AI traffic attribution from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot and other AI assistants.
  • Updated JavaScript tracker to transmit UTM source information.
  • Minor tracking accuracy improvements.

2.3.1

  • Fixed duplicate pageviews caused by repeated tracker events.
  • Improved anonymous visitor handling after consent changes.
  • Improved consistency between dashboard statistics and visitor history.
  • Improved privacy-aware tracking compatibility with consent-based analytics setups.
  • Updated plugin title, tags and readme for WordPress.org visibility.
  • Minor stability and performance improvements.

2.3.0

  • Added AI traffic detection in referrer reports and visitor details.
  • Added support for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Claude, You.com, Phind and Poe referrals.
  • Fixed short technical duplicate pageview counting when the tracker fires twice during the same page load.
  • Preserved repeated real pageviews on the same URL within the same browser session.
  • Added anonymous session-based tracking for visitors who do not grant statistics consent, without creating the persistent lwvs_visitor_id cookie.
  • Preserved the existing persistent visitor tracking for visitors who grant statistics consent.
  • Unified the daily pageview counting logic used by the dashboard, visitor history and page history reports.
  • Added visitor/session pageview detail from the visitor history page.
  • Added full visitor history detail for non-anonymous visitor IDs.
  • Made non-anonymous visitor IDs clickable where visitor IDs are shown in reports.
  • Improved visitor detail and visit detail tables: dates now use the WordPress date/time format and page rows show only the URL.

2.1

  • New Analytics section.
  • Discover pages gaining or losing traffic.
  • New Pages report.
  • Custom analysis period.
  • Improved multilingual support.
  • Added optional uninstall feedback survey.
  • Improved privacy-aware tracking integration.
  • Fixed translation and localization issues.

2.0

  • Added multilingual admin interface.
  • Improved localization.
  • Improved mobile administration pages.
  • Improved email reports.
  • Fixed translation issues.
